pptx-preview.bundle.min.js = pptx-preview 1.0.7 (npm "pptx-preview", license field: ISC; https://www.npmjs.com/package/pptx-preview)
bundled with esbuild (minified) together with:
  JSZip 3.10.2 (MIT option) / lodash 4.x (MIT) / uuid 10 (MIT) / tslib 2.8 (0BSD)
The chart library (Apache ECharts, Apache-2.0) is NOT included: its init() is replaced by an empty stub, so charts are not drawn.
